# Macro indicator: macro-indicator (MACRO)

One headline statistic of one economy: the series, the latest value, the change and the rank among economies. One row per macro indicator, keyed by INDICATOR_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (table `<root>/macro/macro-indicator/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/macro-indicator.jsonl`, 3119 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/macro-indicator.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `INDICATOR_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 3,119 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDICATOR_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^MACRO-` | `"MACRO-ABW-AGRICULTURE"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The economy and the statistic, as one name. | — | `"Aruba · Agriculture, value added"` |
| `INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it (Agriculture, value added). | — | `"Agriculture, value added"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The economy's name (Aruba). | — | `"Aruba"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures: a rate, a share of GDP, a level in US dollars. | one of `% a year`, `% of GDP`, `USD`, `USD bn`, `millions`, `t CO2e` | `"% of GDP"` |
| `DEFINITION` | string | required | The source's definition of the indicator. | — | `"Value added of agriculture, forestry and fishing as a shar…` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The most recent published value of the statistic, in the unit shown. | — | `0.0395295` |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year the latest value refers to. | — | `"2023"` |
| `PREVIOUS` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The value one year before the latest observation, where published. | — | `0.0341749` |
| `PREVIOUS_YEAR` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The year of the previous value the change is measured from. | — | `"2022"` |
| `RANK` | integer | optional (filled in 96% of rows) | The position of the economy among all economies with a value from 2022 or later, highest value first. | — | `193` |
| `OF_COUNT` | integer | optional (filled in 96% of rows) | How many economies the rank is among. | — | `196` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The indicator by year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR (text) and VALUE in the unit of FACTS.UNIT. | — | [9 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the observation. | — | `"2015"` |
| `HISTORY[].VALUE` | number | required | The published value for that year, in the unit shown. | — | `0.0125198` |
| `FACTS` | object | required | About the indicator, one object: INDICATOR, UNIT (% of GDP, t CO2e …), LATEST_YEAR, RANK ("34 of 182", highest value first) and WORLD_BANK_CODE. | — | {…} |
| `FACTS.INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name, the same as INDICATOR. | — | `"Agriculture, value added"` |
| `FACTS.UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures. | one of `% a year`, `% of GDP`, `USD`, `USD bn`, `millions`, `t CO2e` | `"% of GDP"` |
| `FACTS.LATEST_YEAR` | string | required | The year of the latest value. | — | `"2023"` |
| `FACTS.RANK` | string | required | The economy's position among economies with recent data, highest value first. | — | `"193 of 196"` |
| `FACTS.WORLD_BANK_CODE` | string | required | The indicator code in the World Bank API, for looking the series up at the source. | — | `"NV.AGR.TOTL.ZS"` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | required | The economy: an id of the economy kind (ECON-<ISO3>). | pattern `^ECON-`; links to `economy` | `"ECON-ABW"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse; attribution is required. | — | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | — | `"https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-in…` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 3,119 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDICATOR_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDICATOR_ID`, `NAME`, `INDICATOR`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `UNIT`, `DEFINITION`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `HISTORY`, `FACTS`, `ECONOMY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDICATOR_ID` per snapshot.
- `INDICATOR_ID` matches `^MACRO-`.
- `OF_COUNT` is at least 0.
